# DigiWorku — AI & Digital Workforce Platform (India)

> DigiWorku is India's leading digital workforce platform, connecting startups, businesses, and creators with dedicated engineering, UI/UX design, video production, brand identity, and AI automation teams.

## About DigiWorku
- Company: DigiWorku
- Website: https://digiworku.in
- Type: IT & AI Ecosystem / Digital Workforce Platform
- Founded in India; serving clients globally
- Price Range: ₹8,000 – ₹3,50,000 per project

## Core Services
- Web Application & Website Development (React, Next.js, Node.js)
- UI/UX Graphic Design & Brand Identity
- Video Production & Editing
- AI Automation & Systems Engineering
- Growth Marketing & SEO
- Dedicated Remote Engineering Teams / IT Outsourcing
